fees.notes: International student tuition: RM72,600 total. Source: https://www.uniten.edu.my/programme/undergraduate/bachelor-in-finance-honours/ (UNITEN official programme page, accessed 2026-09-18). UNITEN International Undergraduate Fee Structure (Dec 2024) listed RM69,000. per_year = total / 3yr nominal duration.

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 46 (iBT) or MUET Band 3.5; Intensive English Programme (IEP) required if requirement is not met.
requirements.other_qualifications: A-Level with minimum Grade C in any 2 subjects; or STPM with minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in any 2 subjects; or Foundation/Matriculation in a related field with minimum CGPA 2.50; or Diploma in Finance/Banking/Insurance or a related field with minimum CGPA 2.50.
